decisions.reason: Confirmed nonfatal theorem-attribution error in Definition (2): local finiteness is established only on U° by thm-cg-tits-cone-interior-and-local-finiteness (3), while its (4)(ii) supplies infinitely many chambers through a boundary point with infinite parabolic stabilizer. In infinite dihedral type the distinct chamber cones over [k,k+1] all contain 0, so every neighborhood of 0 meets infinitely many chambers. The definition explicitly deferred these properties, so the error does not invalidate its constructions. The same sentence misleadingly attributes general closedness to the named theorems; the literal dihedral union {Δ>0}∪{0} is not closed. Both attributions are corrected.
